# Thanksgiving Hymns Column 27 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** 1QHa (Cave 1), Col. 27 | **Condition:** very fragmentary

---

**27:1** [...] all [...] You have created for Your glory, and [...] according-to [...]

**27:2** [...] the-host-of Your works, and You have assigned [...] in the-service-of [...]

**27:3** [...] Your truth. And You have established the-generations-of [...] for-all [...]

**27:4** [...] the-appointed-times-of eternity, and the-seasons-of [...] You determined [...]

**27:5** [...] to walk before You in the-land-of the-living, and You have opened [...]

**27:6** [...] the-springs-of [...] for Your servant, and the-fountain-of [...] truth [...]

**27:7** [...] for the-sake-of Your glory. And You have created the-breath [...]

**27:8** [...] of every living-thing, and the-regulation-of all their works You have determined [...]

**27:9** [...] and the-mighty-ones who do Your will, and [...] for Your glory [...]

**27:10** [...] You have created [...] for Your honor and for-the-sake-of Your name [...]

**27:11** [...] and the-spirits-of [...] their appointed tasks You have allotted [...]

**27:12** [...] among the-holy-ones, and [...] the-host-of the-angels [...]

**27:13** [...] You have assigned their service before Your glory [...]

**27:14** [...] and the-princes-of [...] in their dominions [...]

**27:15** [...] the-luminaries for their mysteries, and the-stars [...]

**27:16** [...] the-winds for their appointed-rules, and all their works [...]

**27:17** [...] according-to their generations, and the-storehouses [...]

**27:18** [...] lightning and snow and [...] ice [...]

**27:19** [...] in their appointed-seasons for [...] Your purpose [...]

**27:20** [...] for You have established all of them for Your glory [...]

---

*EMET notes: Column 27 is very fragmentary, near the end of the scroll. The surviving fragments describe divine governance of both the angelic realm (spirits, holy ones, host of angels) and the natural world (luminaries, stars, winds, weather). The column reinforces the scroll's theological framework: all creation exists "for Your glory." Line count reduced due to severe manuscript damage.*
